sentences.text: The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — is a partial skeleton that lacks the skull and probably belonged to an individual that was not fully grown.
A sauropod skeleton was found at the Mtuka River, twenty kilometres from Lake Rukwa, in 2004, and the skeleton was excavated between 2005 and 2008.
Mnyamawamtuka was placed in the Titanosauria in 2019.
It is debated whether Mnyamawamtuka belongs outside the Lithostrotia or in a basal position within them as a sister species of Malawisaurus.
